issues.issue: The line is labelled Economic Development, and 'economic development' is an existing disbursement category. It is filed as general government because it is printed under the General Government heading (the extractor flagged it with review). Same kind of call as Noxious Weed Control, which is under Public Works but recorded as natural resources/conservation.

'Personnel Costs' names an object of spending (pay and benefits), not a department. A detail_category of salaries and wages or employee benefits and payroll taxes may fit better than 'not itemized'. It is the largest General Fund spending line.
